challenge.shift: Stronger future shocks, extra future drift/repair frequency

importance.note: Correlated accounting features share information. Permutation/SHAP perturbations need not be feasible ledgers; attribution is not causal.

metric_notes.average_precision: Non-interpolated precision-recall summary; random baseline is prevalence.
metric_notes.calibration: Sigmoid fitted only on calibration businesses. A calibration procedure does not establish good calibration.
metric_notes.intervals: Percentile bootstrap over unique test businesses, conditional on this fitted model and simulator; not real-world uncertainty.
metric_notes.pr_auc_trapezoidal: Trapezoidal area is also supplied and can differ from average precision.

notice: Research demonstration trained on fictional businesses. Scores estimate a synthetic 30-day financial-stress event, not loan default or a validated real-world probability. No lending approval or rejection is produced.
selection_rule: Lowest calibrated validation Brier score, then higher AP, then simpler model. Never final-test performance.

shortcut_audit.interpretation: Small-sample probes cannot prove the absence of leakage or simulation shortcuts.

liquidity_and_supplier_ratio_ablation.note: A decline reveals dependence on near-target financial state; it is not by itself evidence of leakage.

structural_limits: Persistent financial health and current liquidity can make future stress predictable by construction.
Weekly supplier terms, unlimited continued supply and FIFO payment priority are simplified assumptions.
Channel mix and VAS share are independent nuisance features; apparent importance can be sampling noise.
No demographics, sector, business ID, future scenario or future ledger fields enter the predictor.
Shifted synthetic evaluation is not external, temporal or real-world validation.
